Use a region of interest to determine where to focus, zoom, or crop your image in your project extension; for example, you can customize your slideshow’s transitions based on each photo’s highest-quality region of interest, as shown in .
If a project must choose between multiple assets containing the same region of interest, use the metric to choose the best representative.
For projects focused on animation or transition between assets, focus on the regions with the highest weight to ensure that your presentation features areas of greatest interest to the user.
